symptom: Structured QA replay checked out a remediation branch and directly executed that branch's pytest collection and scripts on the scheduler host, allowing pre-merge conftest, plugin, import-time, or replaced script code to access host environment credentials, filesystem, and network.

executable_template.patch_strategy: Route every scheduler-owned QA replay command through a required Bubblewrap boundary that clears the environment, unshares network and namespaces, drops capabilities, exposes the target snapshot read-only, mounts only a trusted external virtualenv plus system runtime paths, and fails the structured QA gate closed if materialization, commit binding, or sandbox execution fails.
